Most problems with a cleaning contract come down to the same three things: a scope nobody wrote down, staff who change every week, and a standard nobody checks. These are the commitments we make instead.
A specification you can hold us to
Every contract starts with a written schedule of tasks and frequencies. The standard is defined in advance, so it can be measured.
A fixed team on your site
The same trained staff attend each visit under a named supervisor. They learn the building, and nobody has to be shown around twice.
Supervisors carry out documented quality walks and report monthly, so problems surface in the review before your tenants raise them.
Our staff are directly employed, trained and fully insured. There is no subcontracting chain, so you always know who is in your building.
